final: WITH observatory_shares AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares_with_average AS (SELECT telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM observatory_shares) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS combined_telescopes, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares_with_average WHERE share > average_share
